description: Room settings (`room.create.settings`, `room.settings.settings`; all optional) and, once validated, `match.started.rules` / `Room.settings`. Integers may be sent as whole floats (3.0). Unknown keys are dropped silently. Validated `rules` always contain every key except seed/city/allow_midmatch_join (when unset), rounds and choose_seconds (when unset).

accident_scale.description: Multiplier on the rules fallback's Final Destination accident chance (1 in 20 per non-attack act at 1).

allow_midmatch_join.description: The core's room flag: humans may join a running match, taking over a bot's seat (its demigod) or a new seat (a live built-in AI demigod, the healthiest; none left: they spectate) from the next round. Copied through only if set.

arena.description: planet: the whole Earth (regions → cities; `city` = where the Final Night converges). city: one real city (districts → sites).

arena_close_beats.description: Time's circle reaches its end radius (1,500 km on the planet) on this beat, and its damage ramps on the same schedule: its own clock, independent of beats_total (a circle scheduled past the Final Night is still closing when it falls).

arm_bless_sparks.description: Rules 0.9.0: sparks a god's blessing on an arming costs (per will part): the gear is a tier up and carries the god's signature.

arm_price_artifact.description: Rules 0.9.0: sparks an artifact-tier arm costs per demigod (a trinket is free).

arm_price_relic.description: Rules 0.9.0: sparks a relic-tier arm costs per demigod.

arms_scale.description: Rules 0.9.0: multiplier on every number an item's modifiers add (strike, damage, guard, regeneration, duel); 0 = gear is decoration.

army_first_host_scale.description: Multiplier on the extra chance a crowd near an unarmed demigod raises their first volunteer host.

army_strike_scale.description: Multiplier on the damage an army does when it storms a demigod.

beat_ms.description: Input alias of flow_ms (used when flow_ms is absent); echoed = flow_ms.

beats_per_day.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats in one game day (dawn, day, dusk, night).

beats_total.description: The Final Night falls on this beat (or earlier: heat death, or nobody standing). One Theatre round = one beat.

bolt_gift.description: Rules 0.7.0: bolts every OTHER player gains when someone casts a mega power.

bolt_start.description: Rules 0.7.0: lightning bolts (the mega currency; also Time's toll and gods' prices) each player starts with. `start_bolts` is an alias.

boon_beats.description: Rules 0.9.0: beats a boon (a blessing, or a critical heal's gift) lasts.

boon_bonus.description: Rules 0.9.0: the d20 bonus a boon gives its demigod's acts.

challenge_contact_km_houses.description: Rules 0.8.1: the contact reach at the houses level (km).

challenge_contact_km_people.description: Rules 0.8.1: the contact reach at the people level (km).

challenge_contact_km_regions.description: Rules 0.8.1: at the regions level a challenge also reaches as far as two touching board cards (km); the reach is max(challenge_min_km, this).

challenge_contact_km_villages.description: Rules 0.8.1: the contact reach at the villages level (km).

challenge_enabled.description: Rules 0.8.1: challenge mode (fields.challenge / fields.duel, and the built-in AI's challenges). Settings recorded before 0.8.1 read it as false.

challenge_min_km.description: Rules 0.8.1: a challenge always reaches this far (km), at any zoom.

choose_seconds.description: Unused by Final Night 7 (there is no Choose phase); copied through if set.

city.description: Arena city by name (fuzzy match). Absent = a seeded pick among cities >= 1M on land.

compose_seconds.description: Compose window (the core's timer, fixed for the room). Default flow_ms / 1000; set it explicitly and it no longer follows flow_ms.

curse_beats.description: Rules 0.9.0: beats an ordinary curse lasts (a seal and a god-tier curse last until countered).

curse_dc.description: Rules 0.9.0: the DC of casting a curse (plus half the target's wardrobe stage).

curse_entropy.description: Rules 0.9.0: Entropy raised by a curse (a god-tier one raises entropy_per_mega).

curse_god_price_sparks.description: Rules 0.9.0: sparks the god-tier variant of a curse costs (strength 3, until countered).

curse_max_per_player.description: Rules 0.9.0: curses and seals one player may have standing at once.

curse_price_sparks.description: Rules 0.9.0: sparks a curse or a seal costs (a bolt breaks into will_spark_per_bolt sparks).

debt_due_beats.description: Beats until a bill falls due (Consequence's per-act bill and Time's bill for orders).

debt_scale.description: Consequence's bill multiplier (echoed back at f32 precision: 0.04, not 0.03999999910593033).

demigods_per_player.description: Rules 0.7.0: 2 = each player's Left and Right hands are two demigods, each with its own health (the player is out when both fall); 1 = one shared body (as before 0.7.0).

dm_encounter_fade_beats.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats an unfound encounter stays marked.

dm_encounters_max.description: Rules 0.8.0: most hidden encounter hexes at once.

dm_encounters_per_beat.description: Rules 0.8.0: encounter hexes the DM may mark per beat.

dm_memory_lines.description: Rules 0.8.0: most memory lines in one LLM DM prompt.

dm_reach_km.description: Rules 0.8.0: the step radius (km): a demigod steps on a hex when its move passes this close (planet; a city arena uses a hundredth).

dm_road_decay.description: Rules 0.8.0: wear an unused path loses per beat.

dm_road_wear.description: Rules 0.8.0: traffic wear at which a path becomes a road.

dm_settlement_step_beats.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats a settlement holds its level before another step.

dm_shrine_heal.description: Rules 0.8.0: a heal shrine's healing per level per beat.

dm_shrine_spark_every.description: Rules 0.8.0: a spark shrine's interval in beats (one fewer per level above 1, at least 2).

dm_shrine_ward.description: Rules 0.8.0: a ward shrine's damage per level per beat to rivals within reach.

duel_ai_aggression.description: State schema 12: how often the typing AI attacks rather than sets a defence, repositions or taunts.

duel_ai_chance.description: Rules 0.8.1: chance per beat that a built-in AI demigod challenges its nearest rival.

duel_ai_handicap.description: State schema 12: subtracted from the d20 modifier of the lines an AI types against a human (waived against a human silent for 12 s, and between two AIs).

duel_ai_lines_per_window.description: State schema 12: the chance an AI fighter types a line of its own in an input window of a duel with a clock (1: every window; 0: off, it only counters as in 0.8.2).

duel_ai_reach_km.description: Rules 0.8.1: a built-in AI demigod's rival beyond regions reach but within this summons it next to it first.

duel_auto_rounds.description: Rules 0.8.1: automatic exchanges in a duel nobody typed in.

duel_cooldown_beats.description: Rules 0.8.1: beats between two challenges by one demigod.

duel_counter_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: a human idle this long is countered automatically.

duel_damage_scale.description: Rules 0.8.1: multiplier on duel blow damage.

duel_deadline_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: the longest a duel runs after its lock (the engine hold's deadline; without a hold the world keeps beating and the duel lasts at most ceil(duel_deadline_ms / flow_ms) resolves).

duel_followup_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: a blow within this of the same side's last is a quick follow-up (+1).

duel_min_gap_ms.description: Rules 0.8.1: a blow sooner than this after the same side's last is a penalty.

duel_one_per_player.description: State schema 12: a player fights one duel at a time: while one of its demigods is in an open duel, a challenge by or to any of its demigods is refused `busy:player` and the AI's chooser skips it.

earth_cold_damage.description: State schema 13: Damage per beat in a blizzard.

earth_crowd_effects.description: State schema 13: Most crowds the field moves in one beat (the worst hit first).

earth_crowd_scale.description: State schema 13: Multiplier on the fear, awe and deaths the field brings crowds.

earth_damage_cap.description: State schema 13: Most damage the field deals one demigod in one beat (before `earth_damage_scale`).

earth_damage_scale.description: State schema 13: Multiplier on the damage the field deals demigods standing in it.

earth_energy_scale.description: State schema 13: Multiplier on every phenomenon's starting power.

earth_events_per_beat.description: State schema 13: Most Earth entries written to the DM's memory in one beat.

earth_fire_damage.description: State schema 13: Damage per beat in a cell burning at full intensity.

earth_flood_damage.description: State schema 13: Damage per beat in a cell flooded to the brim, drowned, or hit by a tidal wave.

earth_keyframe_beats.description: State schema 13: A keyframe of the field is kept every this many beats (any beat is rebuilt by re-simulating at most this many).

earth_km_per_cell.description: State schema 13: A mega's reach in cells is its radius in km over this (1 to 4 cells); a mini is one cell.

earth_lava_damage.description: State schema 13: Damage per beat in a cell deep in lava.

earth_max_cells.description: State schema 13: Most cells that may differ from the base terrain; past it the calmest settle back to base (remembered as `earth.settled`).

earth_max_phenomena.description: State schema 13: Most live phenomena; past it a newcomer replaces the weakest, or is refused.

earth_mini_scale.description: State schema 13: A mini's starting power relative to a mega of the same magnitude.

earth_plate_beats.description: State schema 13: A drifting patch of plate moves one cell every this many beats.

earth_quake_damage.description: State schema 13: Damage in a cell shaking at full strength.

earth_ruin_scale.description: State schema 13: Multiplier on how much a cell's ruin lowers its settlements' level target.

earth_sim_enabled.description: The Earth simulator (state schema 13, docs/EARTH_SIM.md): god powers act on a simulated voxel field of the planet whose fires, floods, quakes and lava reach demigods, crowds and settlements through the rules. Planet arenas only. Absent in settings recorded before it: off.

earth_spontaneous_scale.description: State schema 13: Multiplier on the odds of the world's own phenomena under Entropy (quakes, volcanoes and drifting plates on stressed faults, freak weather).

earth_spread_scale.description: State schema 13: Multiplier on how fast fire, water and swarms spread.

earth_storm_damage.description: State schema 13: Damage from a lightning strike on the cell.

earth_substeps.description: State schema 13: Sub-steps of the field per beat at rest (Entropy 60, 80 and 100 each add one).

earth_swarm_damage.description: State schema 13: Damage per beat in a cell thick with a swarm.

entropy_per_mega.description: Rules 0.7.0: Entropy a mega cast adds (x entropy_scale).

entropy_per_mini.description: Rules 0.7.0: Entropy a mini cast adds (x entropy_scale).

entropy_scale.description: Multiplier on every Entropy rise (a playtest dial; 2 = heat death twice as fast). Cooling is not scaled.

fault_far_damage.description: Rules 0.8.0: damage multiplier far from any fault line.

fault_far_km.description: Rules 0.8.0: a mega this far from any fault line gets the full far penalty.

fault_far_magnitude.description: Rules 0.8.0: magnitude added far from any fault line.

fault_far_radius.description: Rules 0.8.0: radius multiplier far from any fault line.

fault_near_damage.description: Rules 0.8.0: damage multiplier near a fault line.

fault_near_km.description: Rules 0.8.0: a mega this close to a fault line gets the full near bonus.

fault_near_magnitude.description: Rules 0.8.0: magnitude added near a fault line.

fault_near_radius.description: Rules 0.8.0: radius multiplier near a fault line.

final_wish_magnitude.description: Rules 0.7.0: magnitude added to every act of the Final Wish (beat 1).

flow_ms.description: Flow beat length in ms: the world's action runs in beats this long whether or not anyone types. compose_seconds defaults to flow_ms / 1000.

god_power_cost.description: Rules 0.8.0: bolts a god-tier power costs.

god_power_gift.description: Rules 0.8.0: bolts every other player gains per god-tier power.

heal_price_sparks.description: Rules 0.9.0: a heal or blessing costs this + magnitude/4 sparks per target.

heal_scale.description: Rules 0.9.0: multiplier on every will heal (1 + magnitude/4 health per target before it).

heal_token.description: Rules 0.9.0: the token heal of a failed heal roll (the rest waits on its mystic quest).

instant_order_debt.description: Time's flat debt for orders sent without a slow window (bots, the built-in AI, Compose submits that skip action.begin): no repeat or seconds factor; doubled when the bolt can't be paid. Real windows keep 0.5 × (1 + seconds/10) × (1 + 0.5 × recent slows).

item_art_per_match.description: Gear looks: item pictures granted per match (notable items a human player's demigod holds, or lying in a loot pile); lesser and later items keep their icon.

llm.description: false = never call the LLM (every mind uses its rules fallback).

llm_folds_per_beat.description: Folds written by the fold mind per beat (the rest by rules).

look_debounce_beats.description: Gear looks: beats between two new gear images of one demigod (the newest loadout wins when the wait ends).

look_extra_items.description: Gear looks: major items a loadout lists beyond the best item per slot (relic tier and up, god-blessed, or the first item of a new kind).

look_images_per_demigod.description: Gear looks: new gear images (a portrait and a diorama each) one human player's demigod may get per match; beyond it the loadout still updates and the picture stays.

look_items_shown.description: Gear looks: items a gear portrait or diorama shows at most (the loadout's first ones).

looks_enabled.description: Gear looks (the feature gate; needs state schema 11): each demigod's loadout (its best item per slot plus its other major items) is tracked, a human player's demigod gets a new portrait and diorama WITH its gear at each major acquisition, and notable items get item art. Settings recorded before it lack it and read back false (old recordings replay unchanged).

manifest_calls_per_beat.description: Rules 0.7.0: most manifest-mind (LLM) calls per beat (names for wonders and up, and twists).

manifest_muster_scale.description: Rules 0.7.0: a manifested host's army footprint in the simulation, as a share of muster_size(count) (0 = hosts never take the field).

manifest_scale.description: Rules 0.7.0: multiplier on the item engine's bolt price per tier.

max_intents_per_hand.description: Acts one hand turns its speech into per beat (orders sent in the beat they open a window).

max_intents_per_window.description: Acts one hand makes from orders that closed a slow window open at least one beat.

max_memorize_per_beat.description: People memorized from player mentions per beat.

memory_per_owner.description: Live memories per owner before old ones fold into a summary.

mind_timeout_ms.description: Per-call timeout for every LLM mind; a late call takes its rules fallback.

players.description: Demigods in the match (a minimum: every seat gets one; the built-in AI plays the rest).

quest_expire_beats.description: Rules 0.9.0: beats a heal's or an arming's quest stays open (0 = until done); a curse's counter-quest lives as long as its curse, a raising's until the Final Night.

quest_spark_step.description: Rules 0.9.0: sparks a quest's offering step asks for (times the quest's difficulty).

quest_steps_max.description: Rules 0.9.0: the most steps a mystic quest has.

raise_cap.description: Rules 0.9.0: raisings one player may be granted per match (0 = none).

raise_health_fraction.description: Rules 0.9.0: the share of its max health a raised demigod returns with.

raise_price_sparks.description: Rules 0.9.0: Death's base price in sparks to raise a fallen demigod, times 1 + the times it was raised before, plus 1 per raise_stale_beats it has lain dead.

raise_stale_beats.description: Rules 0.9.0: every this many beats a demigod has been dead adds a spark to Death's price.

raise_years.description: Rules 0.9.0: max-health years a raised demigod loses, times 1 + the times it was raised before.

rounds.description: Input-only alias of beats_total (used when beats_total is absent; dropped from `rules`).

rules_0_8_1.description: Rules 0.8.1 marker (always true when validated by a 0.8.1+ server; absent in older recordings).

seed.description: Match seed (u64). Absent = picked at match start (not echoed back in `rules`).

slow_ms.description: How long a slow-time window may stay open (ceil(slow_ms / flow_ms) flow beats).

spark_gift.description: Rules 0.7.0: sparks every OTHER player gains when someone casts a mega power.

spark_start.description: Rules 0.7.0: sparks (the mini currency) each player starts with.

start_bolts.description: Alias of bolt_start (rules 0.7.0: lightning bolts each player starts with).

summon_cooldown_beats.description: Rules 0.8.0: beats between two summonings of one demigod.

summon_enabled.description: Rules 0.8.0: players may summon their demigods (fields.summon).

summon_loss_scale.description: Rules 0.8.0: multiplier on a reckless summoning's health cost.

will_debt_cap.description: Rules 0.9.0: the open debt (health points, per demigod) beyond which the gods finance no more unpaid wills: the will becomes a mystic quest instead.

will_debt_per_spark.description: Rules 0.9.0: debt (to the ruling god) per spark of a will's price the purse could not pay.

will_entropy_per_spark.description: Rules 0.9.0: Entropy raised per spark paid for a will.

will_own_dc.description: Rules 0.9.0: the base DC of a will on your own demigods (heal, bless, arm): DC = this + magnitude/4 (an arming adds 2 per tier). A hostile act's is 8 + magnitude/2.

will_spark_per_bolt.description: Rules 0.9.0: sparks one lightning bolt breaks into when a will's price is paid from bolts (the 1:5 economy; the change stays in the purse as sparks).

wills_ai_chance.description: Rules 0.9.0: how readily the built-in AI uses wills (heals when hurt, arms itself, pleads for its fallen sibling, curses a rival, pursues its quests); 0 = never.

wills_enabled.description: Rules 0.9.0, wills that matter (the feature gate; also needs state schema 7+): a will splits into its parts, healing and blessing your own never just fail, arming makes gear with real modifiers, anyone may plead for a resurrection, seals and curses exist and every one has a mystic counter-quest. Settings recorded before 0.9.0 lack it and read back `false` (old recordings replay unchanged).

title: Final Night 7 room settings
